name: scout-talent-simulator
description: A first-person open-world scout simulator with relaxed drives, explorable interiors, an acoustic soundtrack, and three offline careers.

scripts.test: node tests/career.mjs && node tests/game-journey.mjs && node tests/world.mjs && node tests/audio.mjs && node tests/expedition.mjs && node tests/driving.mjs && node tests/district-life.mjs && node tests/field-journey.mjs && node tests/prologue.mjs && node tests/radio.mjs && node tests/immersive-driving.mjs && node tests/immersive-career.mjs && node tests/immersive-world.mjs && node tests/immersive-driving-spatial.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: node electron/build-support.mjs && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:dmg: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never

author: SCOUT development team
